title: KisanVani
cardDescription: Agriculture web app giving farmers simple access to crop information, farming resources and agricultural services.
overview: KisanVani is an agriculture-focused platform that makes farming information and digital services easier for farmers to access through a simple, responsive interface.
problem: Farmers often lack easy access to reliable crop and farming information in a simple format.
solution: A clean, mobile-friendly platform that organises crop information, farming resources and agricultural services in one place.
result: Farmers and agriculture users can browse farming resources from any device with straightforward navigation.
contributions: Worked on content presentation and UX

challenges.challenge: Designing for users who are new to apps.
challenges.solution: Kept navigation simple with large, clear sections and minimal text input.
